skills.fortitude_title: Fortitude [Z] — Shield equal to 15% of current HP for 5s (Phase 4+, 20s CD)
skills.tsunami_title: Tsunami [Z] — Sweeping wave dealing 4x sword damage (Phase 9+)
skills.iron_will_title: Iron Will [Z] — 46% DMG reduction for 6.9s & retaliatory shrapnel (Phase 4+, 17s CD)
skills.worldroot_title: Worldroot [Z] — Entangle foes in briar thorns for 2.9s & heal 23% max HP over 4s (Phase 4+, 19s CD)
skills.cataclysm_title: Cataclysm [Z] — Slams blade releasing explosive magma eruptions dealing 5.75x DMG (Phase 4+, 15.3s CD)
skills.cyclone_title: Cyclone [Z] — Spinning vortex striking everything within 3x your swing radius for 5.5x DMG (Phase 4+, 35s CD)
skills.freeze_title: Freeze [Z] — Encases every enemy within your average swing range in ice for 5s; frozen targets take double damage (Phase 7+, 25s CD)
skills.blizzard_title: Blizzard [X] — A freezing storm covering 4x your average swing range for 5s, dealing 50% damage every 0.25s and slowing enemies by 15% (Phase 11+, 60s CD)
skills.zap_title: Zap [Z] — Strikes the nearest enemy inside your swing range for 125% damage and stuns it for 1.75s (Phase 5+, 30s CD)
skills.flash_title: Flash [Z] — Blinds and staggers everything within your swing range for 1.4s and deals 220% damage (Phase 7+, 26s CD)
skills.radiance_title: Radiance [X] — A 4s light field around you: burns enemies for 45% damage per second and heals you for 10% of max HP per second (Phase 12+, 50s CD)
skills.gravity_well_title: Gravity Well [Z] — Rips every enemy within 3x your swing range toward you and deals 180% damage (Phase 7+, 30s CD)
skills.erasure_title: Erasure [X] — Instantly erases every enemy below 25% HP within 3x your swing range; everything above takes 200% damage (Phase 12+, 70s CD)
skills.bloodletting_title: Bloodletting [Z] — Pay 15% of your current HP to deal 400% damage to everything within your swing range and heal for 30% of it (Phase 7+, 26s CD)
skills.exsanguinate_title: Exsanguinate [X] — A 5s bleed field: 45% damage per second to everything inside while you heal for 10% of it (Phase 12+, 60s CD)

game_over.title: YOU DIED
game_over.subtitle: Your killstreak has ended in the grassland.

cutscene.dialogue_1: The endless hunger ceases its trembling. All that lived and breathed in this realm... has been consumed.
cutscene.dialogue_2: Seventy-five thousand souls surrendered their essence to forge this final vessel.
cutscene.dialogue_3: The blade transcends mortal flesh, bone, and steel. Reality itself bends to your divine command.
cutscene.dialogue_4: BEHOLD — THE APEX OF CONSUMPTION IS ATTAINED. I AM THE ALL DEVOURER.
cutscene.aquatic_unlock_1: In the beginning, there was only silence... and a single falling drop.
cutscene.aquatic_unlock_2: Two thousand five hundred souls have fallen. Their essence converges into an oceanic wellspring.
cutscene.aquatic_unlock_3: The quiet ripples have begun to stir. Take the blade... and let the deluge commence.
cutscene.aquatic_p13_1: The continents submerge beneath a boundless, unforgiving abyss.
cutscene.aquatic_p13_2: One hundred and forty-five thousand lives swept away into the infinite tide.
cutscene.aquatic_p13_3: Every drop of water in existence now answers to your pulse. Phase 13 — Omnitidal. The deluge is complete.
cutscene.soil_unlock_1: Deep beneath the soil, ancient roots awaken.
cutscene.soil_unlock_2: Three thousand five hundred battles have nourished the earth beneath your feet.
cutscene.soil_unlock_3: I'm... just dirt. But I'll protect what I can.
cutscene.soil_unlock_4: Take me. Together, we will make sure nothing ever reaches your treasure.
cutscene.soil_p10_1:
[The screen briefly darkens.]

You thought I had fallen?
cutscene.soil_p10_2:
[The broken blade sinks into the ground.]

No.

I returned to where I began.
cutscene.soil_p10_3:
[The ground begins trembling. Cracks spread outward from the sword.]

Every grain...
Every fragment...
Every piece of me that was broken...
cutscene.soil_p10_4:
[The scattered dirt from previous phases begins floating toward the blade.]

...was still mine.
cutscene.soil_p10_5:
[Massive layers of earth rise from the ground and surround the sword.]

I spent every battle learning how to endure.
Every defeat taught me how to rebuild.
cutscene.soil_p10_6:
[The earth rapidly compresses, becoming incredibly dense and towering.]

I am no longer loose dirt.
I am no longer merely a blade.
cutscene.soil_p10_7:
[The entire structure erupts into a colossal fortress-like sword.]

I am the ground beneath your feet.
The wall between your treasure and everything that seeks to take it.
cutscene.soil_p10_8:
[The fortress settles into complete silence.]

Come.
Break yourself against me.
cutscene.soil_p10_9:
As long as I stand...
Your treasure will never be taken.
cutscene.metallic_unlock_1: From raw iron and molten fire, an unyielding will takes shape.
cutscene.metallic_unlock_2: Five thousand foes have fallen before your resolve. The steel recognizes its master.
cutscene.metallic_unlock_3: I was discarded once. Now, I have another purpose.
cutscene.metallic_unlock_4: Hold me firm. We will bend neither to hardship nor death.
cutscene.metallic_p10_1:
[The sword ceases all vibration. The air around it feels unnaturally heavy.]

There is nothing left to temper.
cutscene.metallic_p10_2:
[The scratches on the blade begin to glow with cold white light.]

Every strike against me...
Every blow meant to shatter me...
cutscene.metallic_p10_3:
[The cracks and dents fill in, not by healing, but by folding into denser steel.]

...was simply another hammer blow.
cutscene.metallic_p10_4:
[A ringing sound echoes—like an anvil struck in an empty cathedral.]

I was scrap.
I became a weapon.
cutscene.metallic_p10_5:
[The blade transforms into perfectly polished, dark silver steel. No reflections appear on its surface.]

Now...
cutscene.metallic_p10_6:
[The white glow settles deep inside the core of the blade.]

I am the standard against which all force is measured.
cutscene.metallic_p10_7:
[The sword emits a low, steady hum that does not fade.]

Bring your worst.
Bring everything.
cutscene.metallic_p10_8:
[The screen flashes pure white for a fraction of a second.]

I will not bend.
I will not break.
cutscene.metallic_p10_10: And I will outlast all of you.
cutscene.flora_unlock_1: Leaves rustle as ancient roots stir beneath the emerald meadow.
cutscene.flora_unlock_2: Seven thousand slaughters have fertilized the timeless grove. The forest awakens.
cutscene.flora_unlock_3: A sprout in the storm... but patience outlives all tempests.
cutscene.flora_unlock_4: Take root with me. Together, we shall endure longer than the mountains.
cutscene.flora_p10_1:
[Roots slowly retreat into the soil. The world falls completely still.]

You fought so hard.
cutscene.flora_p10_2:
[Green light pulses softly through the ground, spreading outward in all directions.]

You conquered empires.
You built monuments.
You swung your weapons with such fury.
cutscene.flora_p10_3:
[Vines begin growing over everything—the arena, the weapons, the fallen.]

And yet...
cutscene.flora_p10_4:
[Flowers bloom in the cracks of broken armor.]

...the grass always returns.
cutscene.flora_p10_5:
[Massive ancient roots erupt from the earth, interlocking into an immense living sword.]

I do not need to defeat you.
I only need to exist.
cutscene.flora_p10_6:
[Leaves drift down, glowing with calm, pale green light.]

Your strength will fade.
Your iron will rust.
Your fires will die.
cutscene.flora_p10_7:
[The living sword pulses with slow, heartbeat-like warmth.]

And when everything you built has turned to dust...
cutscene.flora_p10_8:
[A single new sprout opens at the tip of the blade.]

...I will still be growing.
cutscene.flora_p10_11: It only takes back what was always its own.
cutscene.hellfire_unlock_1: The air scorches with suffocating heat as obsidian fissures rip open.
cutscene.hellfire_unlock_2: Ten thousand souls burned away in your crucible of slaughter. The demon within demands release.
cutscene.hellfire_unlock_3: A spark... it is enough to ignite the world.
cutscene.hellfire_unlock_4: Unleash me! Feed me! Let nothing remain but ash!
cutscene.hellfire_p10_1:
[The flames completely disappear. The screen goes pitch black.]

...
cutscene.hellfire_p10_2:
[A single red line appears down the center of the screen, splitting the darkness.]

You thought it was a fire you could put out?
cutscene.hellfire_p10_3:
[The red line tears open into an ocean of black and crimson fire.]

FIRE DOES NOT NEGOTIATE.
cutscene.hellfire_p10_4:
[The sword reappears—surrounded by jagged obsidian horns and swirling black flame.]

It does not pause.
It does not show mercy.
cutscene.hellfire_p10_5:
[The ground around the sword melts instantly into bubbling magma.]

It only consumes.
cutscene.hellfire_p10_6:
[The blade erupts with a sound like a volcanic explosion.]

You brought me foes.
You brought me souls.
You gave me everything I needed to burn through the cage.
cutscene.hellfire_p10_7:
[Pillars of black fire shoot skyward, turning the sky dark red.]

Now...
cutscene.hellfire_p10_8:
[The sword burns with fire so dark it absorbs the light around it.]

THERE IS NOTHING LEFT TO HOLD ME BACK.
cutscene.hellfire_p10_9:
[Violent tremors shake the entire screen. The fire roars with terrifying intensity.]

BURN!
cutscene.windy_unlock_1: A faint current slips past your shoulder. It does not push. It waits.
cutscene.windy_unlock_2: Twenty-four thousand kills, and not one of them left a mark on the air.
cutscene.windy_unlock_3: Can you feel that? Something is moving.
cutscene.windy_unlock_4: It follows you now. Tell it where to strike.
cutscene.windy_p13_1: [The wind stops. Completely. Not a leaf moves. The silence is louder than the storm ever was.]
cutscene.windy_p13_4:
[The horizon folds inward. Every rotating layer of sky answers at once.]

There is only the storm.
cutscene.frostbite_unlock_1: Thirty-two thousand, five hundred kills. Something in the air has stopped moving.
cutscene.frostbite_unlock_3: That's all it is. Not yet a weapon - just a shape that refuses to warm up.
cutscene.frostbite_unlock_4: But the cold is spreading. Tell it where.
cutscene.frostbite_p12_1: [The frost stops falling. It simply hangs, suspended, waiting for permission to move.]
cutscene.frostbite_p12_4:
[Every layer of ice goes still at the same instant. Nothing melts. Nothing breaks.]

This is absolute zero.
cutscene.voltstrike_unlock_1: Forty-five thousand. Not one of them was ever given time to react.
cutscene.voltstrike_unlock_2: There is no charge in this blade yet. Only the shape of one.
cutscene.voltstrike_unlock_3: The first spark is the only honest one. Everything after it is just more.
cutscene.voltstrike_unlock_4: Whatever it strikes, it strikes once. Choose.
cutscene.voltstrike_p14_1: [The discharge stops. For one instant the blade is completely silent - and then it is not.]
cutscene.voltstrike_p14_4:
You were wrong.

[The sword begins violently discharging.] This is something worse.
cutscene.lumen_unlock_1: Fifty thousand. You did not notice the light changing until it had already changed.
cutscene.lumen_unlock_2: I am not warm. Do not mistake me for warm.
cutscene.lumen_unlock_3: I am what is left when the light stops asking permission.
cutscene.lumen_unlock_4: Hold me up. Then look away, if you still can.
cutscene.lumen_p14_1: [The shadow under your feet thins, then goes. Nothing standing here casts one any more.]
cutscene.lumen_p14_2: You kept calling me a sword.
cutscene.lumen_p14_3: A sword ends somewhere. I do not.
cutscene.lumen_p14_4:
[Every layer of light stops moving at once and simply is.]

There is no edge of me left to find.
cutscene.umbra_unlock_1: Seventy thousand. Count them again. You will find the number is smaller than you remember.
cutscene.umbra_unlock_2: Something has been taking them. It was never you.
cutscene.umbra_unlock_3: I am not dark. Dark is a thing. I am the space a thing leaves.
cutscene.umbra_unlock_4: Point me at something. Then watch how little is left.
cutscene.umbra_p15_1: [Every sound arrives late, as though it had to travel around something that is not there.]
cutscene.umbra_p15_3: Weapons carry an absence around with them.
cutscene.umbra_p15_4:
I do not carry it. [The air where the blade should be stops behaving like air.]

I am the absence.
cutscene.sanguine_unlock_1: One hundred thousand. Your hands have not stopped shaking since the ninetieth.
cutscene.sanguine_unlock_2: Good. That is not fear. That is me, arriving.
cutscene.sanguine_unlock_3: I am small. I am thinner than anything you have carried.
cutscene.sanguine_unlock_4: But I am already in you. Give me somewhere to go.
cutscene.sanguine_p16_1: [The beat lands once. Everything standing in the room misses one of its own.]
cutscene.sanguine_p16_2: You thought I was taking their blood.
cutscene.sanguine_p16_4:
[The blade goes white-hot and the beat lands again, twice as hard.]

I was keeping it.

arcanist.desc: Mystic spellcaster channeling raw arcane volatility.

colossus.desc: Ancient monolithic titan of primordial stone.

starforged.desc: Cosmic construct forged from fallen astral debris.

grizzlehorn.name: Grizzlehorn
grizzlehorn.desc: Heavily plated beast with sweeping bronze armor horns.

brambleback.name: Brambleback
brambleback.desc: Spiny briar beast bristling with toxic radial thorns.

embermane.name: Embermane
embermane.desc: Ferocious flaming feline entity radiating intense volcanic heat.

duskhorn.name: Duskhorn
duskhorn.desc: Twilight beast crowned with long crystalline obsidian horns.

mirewalker.name: Mirewalker
mirewalker.desc: Deep-marsh cyclopean wanderer enveloped in toxic spores.

thunderhoof.name: Thunderhoof
thunderhoof.desc: Crackling storm-beast discharging lethal electric arcs.

gloomscale.name: Gloomscale
gloomscale.desc: Abyssal serpentine dragon cloaked in shadowy layered void scales.

wildtusk.name: Wildtusk
wildtusk.desc: Prehistoric dread-boar armed with razor-sharp war tusks.

moonmane.name: Moonmane
moonmane.desc: Celestial astral guardian radiating pure celestial lunar luminescence.

crimsonhide.name: Crimsonhide
crimsonhide.desc: Apocalyptic apex behemoth encased in blood-crystalline dragon carapace.

devourer.name: Devourer
devourer.description: An insatiable predatory blade that consumes enemy essence to empower its wielder, progressing across 17 phases up to 75,000 killstreak.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.description: A hyper-velocity speed blade with alternating white and crimson resonance. Progresses across 7 phases from a needle rapier into a divine godspeed katana, reaching 300 walk speed.

aquatic.name: Aquatic
aquatic.description: A liquid evolutionary blade that ascends from a harmless droplet into a planetary cataclysm across 13 phases, featuring the signature Tsunami skill.

soil.name: Soil
soil.description: A defensive, HP-focused sword that gradually evolves from a crude dirt blade into an indestructible soil fortress across 10 phases. Features the Fortitude [Z] shield skill.

metallic.name: Metallic
metallic.description: Born from raw metal and gradually forged into something that cannot bend or break. Unlocks the Iron Will [Z] hardening stance.

flora.name: Flora
flora.description: A living sword that grows stronger through every battle, eventually becoming an embodiment of unstoppable natural growth. Features Worldroot [Z].

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.description: An infernal weapon that feeds on destruction and grows increasingly difficult to contain. Features Cataclysm [Z].

windy.name: Windy
windy.description: An aerial weapon that grows through movement and atmospheric pressure rather than weight. Features Cyclone [Z].

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.description: A freezing weapon that overwhelms the battlefield by taking movement away rather than outrunning the enemy. Features Freeze [Z] and Blizzard [X].

voltstrike.name: Voltstrike
voltstrike.description: A lightning weapon built for a single target: precision strikes and overwhelming electrical damage rather than area control. Features Zap [Z].

lumen.name: Lumen
lumen.description: A radiant weapon that is strong almost immediately and then grows slowly: the light it holds arrives all at once, and everything after that is refinement. Features Flash [Z] and Radiance [X].

umbra.name: Umbra
umbra.description: A void weapon that is already strong the moment you hold it and then climbs in a straight, unbroken line — no spike, no collapse in its power, only a steadily deepening absence. Features Gravity Well [Z] and Erasure [X].

sanguine.name: Sanguine
sanguine.description: A blood weapon that starts as the weakest thing in the game and ends as the strongest: for six phases it can barely hold itself together, and then it stops holding back. Features Bloodletting [Z] and Exsanguinate [X].

1.name: Phase 1: Hunger
1.effects: Basic bone steel edge. Base 5 DMG and 100 HP. Consumes essence from kills to scale in the active phase.

2.name: Phase 2: Feast
2.effects: Satiated edge. Base 18 DMG and 180 HP. Cleaves through flesh with hungry fervor.

3.name: Phase 3: Devourer
3.effects: Awakened predatory entity. Base 32 DMG and 280 HP. Siphons life with abyssal resonance.

4.name: Phase 4: Voracity
4.effects: Ravenous devouring fervor. Base 55 DMG and 450 HP. Blazes with scorching hunger.

5.name: Phase 5: Apex Maw
5.effects: Apex dominance. Base 95 DMG and 750 HP with wide sweeping 180° cleaves.

6.name: Phase 6: World Eater
6.effects: The cosmic calamity. Base 160 DMG and 1,200 HP. Consumes matter across extensive sweeping arcs.

7.name: Phase 7: Cosmic Calamity
7.effects: Galactic essence consumed. Base 260 DMG and 1,800 HP. Broad cleaves tear cosmic rifts.

8.name: Phase 8: Void Singularity
8.effects: Bottomless hunger event horizon. Base 400 DMG and 2,600 HP with crushing void pull.

9.name: Phase 9: Starved Husk
9.effects: A burned-out, starving husk. Senses dim to base 40 DMG, 58 HP, and 17 SPD. Requires exactly +250 kills to awaken.

10.name: Phase 10: Ascended Behemoth
10.effects: Cataclysmic resurrection! Base 650 DMG and 4,000 HP. Unlocks Gluttony [Z] forward energy beam.

11.name: Phase 11: Cosmic Devourer
11.effects: The cosmic devourer awakens. Base 1,000 DMG, 6,000 HP, and 126 speed with sweeping solar cleaves.

12.name: Phase 12: Abyssal Sovereign
12.effects: Sovereign of the deep abyss. Massive flanged dual-edged blade inflicting base 1,550 devastation damage and 9,000 HP.

13.name: Phase 13: Singularity Core
13.effects: Gravitational event horizon. Orbiting black hole core dealing base 2,300 void damage and 13,500 HP across wide arcs.

14.name: Phase 14: Eldritch Eclipse
14.effects: Twin-horned solar eclipse scythe. Burns through enemy ranks with base 3,400 incinerating damage and 19,000 HP.

15.name: Phase 15: Cosmic Oblivion
15.effects: Transcendent astral constellation blade. Base 4,800 DMG and 25,000 HP shattering reality.

16.name: Phase 16: Ashen Dormancy
16.effects: Transitional slumber before final ascension. Senses dull to base 138 DMG and 345 HP. Requires exactly +1,000 kills to reach the apex.

17.name: Phase 17: The All Devourer
17.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION. The absolute zenith of existence. Base 6,500 DMG, 30,000 HP, divine aura, and permanent All Devourer badge. Unlocks Engulf [X].

1.name: Phase 1: Quick Silver
1.effects: Slender white needle rapier with crimson accents. Base 8 DMG, 120 HP, and 50 SPD.
1.notification: The needle stirs with kinetic potential.

2.name: Phase 2: Velocity Sting
2.effects: Enhanced crimson velocity rapier with rapid acceleration. Base 24 DMG, 260 HP, and 80 SPD.

3.name: Phase 3: Sonic Piercer
3.effects: Elaborate sonic rapier whistling past the sound barrier. Base 65 DMG, 550 HP, and 115 SPD.
3.notification: Faster than the eye can follow.

4.name: Phase 4: Tachyon Edge
4.effects: Transitional tachyon speed blade warping perception. Base 180 DMG, 1,400 HP, and 155 SPD.

5.name: Phase 5: Flash Katana
5.effects: Katana transformation! Slashing arcs of white lightning. Base 650 DMG, 4,500 HP, and 200 SPD.

6.name: Phase 6: Godspeed Blade
6.effects: Advanced fancy katana shattering the sonic threshold. Base 2,100 DMG, 12,000 HP, and 250 SPD.
6.notification: Reality fractures beneath the sonic wake.

7.name: Phase 7: Apex Godspeed
7.effects: FINAL OVERDRIVE TRANSFORMATION. Majestic divine-speed katana. Base 5,500 DMG, 25,500 HP, and 300 SPD.
7.notification: You have become the speed beyond gods.

1.name: Phase 1: Droplet
1.effects: A single trembling water drop upon the blade. Base 15 DMG and 150 HP.
1.notification: A single drop rests upon the blade.

2.name: Phase 2: Ripple
2.effects: Water begins circulating with momentum. Produces circular ripples on hit.

3.name: Phase 3: Stream
3.effects: A fluid stream flows around the blade. Leaves short water trails on swing.

4.name: Phase 4: Current
4.effects: Accelerated current with cyan edge and white core. Water spirals with purpose.

5.name: Phase 5: Undertow
5.effects: Constant water vortex underneath player. Base 300 DMG and 3,500 HP.

6.name: Phase 6: Maelstrom
6.effects: Dual rotating water rings and swirling vortex consuming matter. Base 550 DMG and 6,000 HP.

7.name: Phase 7: Deep
7.effects: Deep abyssal pressure. Wet trail while moving and crushing dark water aura. Base 900 DMG and 9,000 HP.

8.name: Phase 8: Drought
8.effects: POWER COLLAPSE. Senses dim to 30 DMG and 300 HP. Droplets evaporate. Requires +750 kills to awaken.

9.name: Phase 9: Flood
9.effects: VIOLENT ERUPTION! Base 2,000 DMG and 15,000 HP. Unlocks signature skill: TSUNAMI [Z] (4x DMG = 8,000).
9.notification: The silence breaks. THE FLOOD HAS BEGUN.

10.name: Phase 10: Monsoon
10.effects: Storm generator. Rain particles fall from the sky. Base 4,000 DMG, 25,000 HP. Tsunami deals 16,000 DMG.
10.notification: One wave becomes a storm. THE MONSOON RISES.

11.name: Phase 11: Cataclysm
11.effects: The sea escapes its boundaries. Camera shake on attacks. Base 7,000 DMG, 38,000 HP. Tsunami deals 28,000 DMG.
11.notification: The sea has escaped its boundaries. CATACLYSM.

12.name: Phase 12: Leviathan
12.effects: Ancient leviathan silhouette manifests behind wielder. Base 11,500 DMG, 50,000 HP. Tsunami deals 46,000 DMG.
12.notification: Something beneath the ocean awakens. THE LEVIATHAN RISES.

13.name: Phase 13: Omnitidal
13.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: WALKING NATURAL DISASTER. Base 18,000 DMG, 62,000 HP. Tsunami deals 72,000 cataclysmic damage.
13.notification: There is no ocean left to conquer. Because you have become it. OMNITIDAL.

1.name: Phase 1: Dirt Blade
1.effects: Crude blade pressed from moist topsoil. Base 3 DMG, 250 HP, and 10 SPD.
1.notification: You hold me, weak and crumbling. But inside... there is a seed.

2.name: Phase 2: Packed Earth
2.effects: Densely packed soil bonded with roots. Base 15 DMG, 800 HP, and 15 SPD.
2.notification: The roots tighten. I will not let anything reach you.

3.name: Phase 3: Clay Shard
3.effects: Sun-baked earthen edge with hardened clay ridges. Base 50 DMG, 2,200 HP, and 21 SPD.
3.notification: The heat bakes us solid. You are safe behind me.

4.name: Phase 4: Loam Edge
4.effects: Ancient compacted soil with active mineral veins. Base 150 DMG, 5,500 HP, and 28 SPD. Unlocks Fortitude [Z] shield barrier.
4.notification: Drink from the earth! Stand your ground — I am your shield!

5.name: Phase 5: Stoneheart
5.effects: Heavy petrified soil blade fused with granite veins. Base 400 DMG, 13,000 HP, and 36 SPD.
5.notification: Let them strike. Every blow only presses the soil firmer.

6.name: Phase 6: Terrene Bastion
6.effects: Layered tectonic edge humming with seismic density. Base 950 DMG, 28,000 HP, and 47 SPD.
6.notification: A fortress is not built in a day. We are the foundation.

7.name: Phase 7: Bedrock Cleaver
7.effects: Unyielding mantle bedrock blade wrapped in stone runes. Base 2,100 DMG, 58,000 HP, and 60 SPD.
7.notification: Bedrock does not break. Neither do we.

8.name: Phase 8: Mountain's Will
8.effects: Towering monolithic soil fortress with orbiting bedrock bulwarks. Base 4,200 DMG, 115,000 HP, and 76 SPD.
8.notification: Nothing moves the mountain. Stand fast, my treasure.

9.name: Phase 9: Crumbling Husk
9.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. Soil sheds its heavy shell, cracking down to base 135 DMG, 5,000 HP, and 96 SPD. Endure 40,000 kills to reveal the core.
9.notification: Wait... the outer layers are falling away... hold on, trust me, DO NOT LET GO—

10.name: Phase 10: Indestructible Soil Fortress
10.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION. The ultimate continental bulwark. Base 8,500 DMG, 315,000 HP, and 120 SPD. Grants permanent Indestructible Soil Fortress badge.
10.notification: THE SEED HAS SPROUTED. I AM THE FORTRESS. NOTHING CAN HARM MY TREASURE NOW.

1.name: Phase 1: Scrap
1.effects: A crude discarded metal shard. Base 5 DMG and 180 HP.
1.notification: I was discarded once. Now, I have another purpose.

2.name: Phase 2: Forged
2.effects: The metal has passed through intense forge fire. Base 22 DMG and 650 HP.
2.notification: The heat changed me. I will not remain weak.

3.name: Phase 3: Tempered
3.effects: Hammered and water-quenched crystalline steel forms. Base 70 DMG and 1,800 HP.
3.notification: Every strike leaves a mark. Every mark makes me harder.

4.name: Phase 4: Steelbound
4.effects: Solid steel plating. Unlocks Iron Will [Z] (40% DMG reduction & retaliatory shrapnel for 6s). Base 200 DMG and 4,800 HP.
4.notification: I have learned to endure. Strike me again.

5.name: Phase 5: Reinforced
5.effects: Layered steel laminated across the spine. Base 480 DMG and 11,000 HP.
5.notification: Another layer. Another weakness removed. I am becoming stronger.

6.name: Phase 6: Hardened
6.effects: Unmatched metallurgical density under crushing pressure. Base 1,000 DMG and 24,000 HP.
6.notification: Pressure does not frighten me. Pressure creates me.

7.name: Phase 7: Forgemaster
7.effects: The blade commands the ancient fire and anvil. Base 2,100 DMG and 50,000 HP.
7.notification: The earth gave me my material. The forge gave me my purpose.

8.name: Phase 8: Iron Fortress
8.effects: Bastion plating encases the user in unyielding armor. Base 4,200 DMG and 110,000 HP.
8.notification: I no longer need a shield. I am the shield.

9.name: Phase 9: Unyielding
9.effects: Impervious to any force that attempts to bend or break it. Base 7,500 DMG and 210,000 HP.
9.notification: You cannot bend me. You cannot break me.

10.name: Phase 10: Eternal Steel
10.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ETERNAL STEEL. Monolithic, perfectly refined divine blade. Base 11,500 DMG, 360,000 HP, and 125 SPD.
10.notification: I do not bend. I do not break. I endure.

1.name: Phase 1: Sprout
1.effects: A fragile yet resilient living sprout blade. Base 4 DMG and 220 HP.
1.notification: I was only a seed. Even seeds know how to survive.

2.name: Phase 2: Rooted
2.effects: Fibrous roots anchor the blade directly to the soil. Base 18 DMG and 750 HP.
2.notification: My roots are spreading. I am beginning to take hold.

3.name: Phase 3: Growing
3.effects: Vigorous woody stems wrap tightly around the blade spine. Base 60 DMG and 2,100 HP.
3.notification: Every battle feeds me. Every victory makes me grow.

4.name: Phase 4: Thorned
4.effects: Vicious briar thorns line the cutting edge. Unlocks Worldroot [Z] (Entangles foes and regenerates 20% max HP). Base 180 DMG and 5,600 HP.
4.notification: Growth alone is not enough. Even flowers need thorns.

5.name: Phase 5: Wild
5.effects: Uninhibited wild jungle flora surges with primordial vitality. Base 440 DMG and 13,000 HP.
5.notification: You call this overgrowth? I have barely begun.

6.name: Phase 6: Ancient
6.effects: Millennia of arboreal memory hardens the blade into ironwood. Base 950 DMG and 28,000 HP.
6.notification: I have survived countless seasons. You will not outlast me.

7.name: Phase 7: Overgrown
7.effects: Canopies of living foliage expand from the blade across the ground. Base 2,000 DMG and 60,000 HP.
7.notification: The ground beneath you belongs to me. You simply haven't noticed yet.

8.name: Phase 8: Colossus
8.effects: A colossal arboreal titan blade radiating ancient planetary vitality. Base 4,000 DMG and 130,000 HP.
8.notification: I have grown beyond a sword. I am becoming something greater.

9.name: Phase 9: Worldroot
9.effects: The planetary root system pulses through the blade. Base 7,800 DMG and 240,000 HP.
9.notification: My roots have reached farther than you can see. Where there is soil, I am there.

10.name: Phase 10: Evergrowth
10.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: EVERGROWTH. Planetary embodiment of unstoppable nature. Base 12,000 DMG, 400,000 HP, and 130 SPD.
10.notification: Cut me down. I will grow back.

1.name: Phase 1: Ember
1.effects: A smoldering ember clinging to charcoal steel. Base 7 DMG and 140 HP.
1.notification: A tiny spark. That's all I need.

2.name: Phase 2: Flame
2.effects: Steady infernal fire coats the blade spine. Base 28 DMG and 500 HP.
2.notification: Now I burn. Give me something to consume.

3.name: Phase 3: Blazing
3.effects: Violent flames crackle outward with every swipe. Base 90 DMG and 1,500 HP.
3.notification: Every kill feeds the flame. Keep them coming.

4.name: Phase 4: Infernal
4.effects: Infernal hellfire bursts across the blade. Unlocks Cataclysm [Z] (Magma eruption dealing 5x DMG). Base 260 DMG and 4,200 HP.
4.notification: You wanted power? Then face the fire.

5.name: Phase 5: Hellborn
5.effects: Deep volcanic runes ignite along obsidian steel. Base 650 DMG and 10,000 HP.
5.notification: The flames know my name. Do you?

6.name: Phase 6: Magma
6.effects: Liquid magma seeps from molten fissures in the sword. Base 1,400 DMG and 22,000 HP.
6.notification: My fire has reached the earth. Now even the ground burns.

7.name: Phase 7: Devastation
7.effects: Total incendiary erasure of all matter before the wielder. Base 2,800 DMG and 48,000 HP.
7.notification: I no longer burn what stands before me. I erase it.

8.name: Phase 8: Cataclysm
8.effects: Hellfire storm encircles the sword; nowhere is safe. Base 5,600 DMG and 100,000 HP.
8.notification: Look around. There is nowhere left to run.

9.name: Phase 9: Apocalypse
9.effects: The blade roars with the burning heat of an ending universe. Base 10,500 DMG and 190,000 HP.
9.notification: Do you hear that? That's the sound of everything burning.

10.name: Phase 10: Hellfire
10.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: THE INFERNAL. Uncontainable world-ending inferno. Base 16,800 DMG, 320,000 HP, and 145 SPD.

1.name: Phase 1: Breeze
1.effects: A faint current of air wrapped around a simple blade. Base 15 DMG and 40 HP.

2.name: Phase 2: Draft
2.effects: The wind has begun following the wielder. Small particles drift around the blade. Base 25 DMG and 120 HP.

3.name: Phase 3: Gust
3.effects: The breeze becomes capable of force. Noticeable wind trails and a small circular airflow. Base 50 DMG and 300 HP.
3.notification: A breeze can become a force.

4.name: Phase 4: Airflow
4.effects: The air begins behaving almost intelligently. Unlocks Cyclone [Z] (Spinning vortex dealing 5.5x DMG across 3x the normal swing radius). Base 100 DMG and 650 HP.

5.name: Phase 5: Gale
5.effects: The sword no longer carries the wind; the wind begins to carry the sword. Base 220 DMG and 1,500 HP.

6.name: Phase 6: Squall
6.effects: The wind becomes violent and unpredictable, distorting the air around the wielder. Base 500 DMG and 3,000 HP.
6.notification: It is no longer a breeze.

7.name: Phase 7: Tempest
7.effects: The first true storm. A large wind aura, dense particles and floating debris. Base 4,500 DMG and 12,500 HP.

8.name: Phase 8: Calm
8.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The storm goes silent and the blade falls back to its barest form. Base 250 DMG and 500 HP. Survive the quiet to be reforged.

9.name: Phase 9: Awakening
9.effects: The wind returns, and it is no longer the same wind. Aura reforming around strengthening vortexes. Base 3,500 DMG and 8,000 HP.
9.notification: The silence was never the end.

10.name: Phase 10: Cyclone
10.effects: The wind forms organized destructive patterns. Large circular trails and rotating particles. Base 9,000 DMG and 20,000 HP.

11.name: Phase 11: Typhoon
11.effects: The storm becomes enormous, swallowing the horizon in rotating layers of wind. Base 17,500 DMG and 38,000 HP.

12.name: Phase 12: Supercell
12.effects: The sword has become a catastrophic atmospheric phenomenon with constant movement. Base 35,000 DMG and 67,000 HP.
12.notification: The sky has become your weapon.

13.name: Phase 13: Ultimate Tempest
13.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ULTIMATE TEMPEST. Windy is no longer controlling the wind — Windy has become the storm. Base 70,000 DMG, 145,000 HP, and 220 SPD. Become the tempest.

1.name: Phase 1: Ice Cube
1.effects: A tiny piece of frozen matter shaped into a sword. Pale, sparse, almost no particles. Base 4 DMG and 20 HP.

2.name: Phase 2: Frost
2.effects: A thin frost layer spreads across the blade, with small ice crystals and faint particles. Base 12 DMG and 50 HP.

3.name: Phase 3: Chill
3.effects: More crystals form and a faint cold mist drifts off the blade. Base 40 DMG and 125 HP.

4.name: Phase 4: Icebound
4.effects: Thick ice formations encase the blade and the handle frosts over, trailing ice particles on every swing. Base 105 DMG and 500 HP.

5.name: Phase 5: Frozen
5.effects: The sword begins freezing the battlefield itself: frost trails, cold mist and frozen impact effects. Base 315 DMG and 1,250 HP.
5.notification: The world slows in the cold.

6.name: Phase 6: Glacier
6.effects: The first major form: a glacier-like blade with heavy ice formations, a thick frost aura and ice shards on impact. Base 860 DMG and 3,250 HP.
6.notification: The glacier awakens. Everything beneath it will freeze.

7.name: Phase 7: Shatter
7.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The glacier breaks: a cracked, fragmentary weapon with almost no aura. Unlocks Freeze [Z] — encases enemies in ice for 5s, doubling all damage they take. Base 6 DMG and 40 HP.
7.notification: ...Crack. Something broke. But not the cold.

8.name: Phase 8: Permafrost
8.effects: The ice reforms stronger than before: larger crystals, a strong frost aura, frozen ground effects and floating shards. Base 6,766 DMG and 8,675 HP.
8.notification: It survived the fracture. Now it remembers.

9.name: Phase 9: Deep Freeze
9.effects: The cold becomes oppressive: dense frost mist, large crystals and ice spreading across the ground. Base 15,000 DMG and 16,666 HP.

10.name: Phase 10: Frozen Wasteland
10.effects: The sword creates its own frozen environment: massive ice structures, snow, frozen ground and shards constantly forming and breaking. Base 52,000 DMG and 89,000 HP.
10.notification: There is no warmth left. Only ice.

11.name: Phase 11: Fracture
11.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. Enormous power becomes unstable: large cracks, missing ice sections and a weak frost aura. Unlocks Blizzard [X] — a 5s freezing storm dealing 50% damage every 0.25s and slowing enemies by 15%. Base 1,333 DMG and 3,333 HP.
11.notification: Too much... Even ice can break. ...But can it melt?

12.name: Phase 12: Absolute Zero
12.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ABSOLUTE ZERO. A glacier made into a weapon — layered translucent ice, constant snow, crystalline structures and frozen ground. Frostbite no longer freezes things; it stops them. Base 165,000 DMG, 366,000 HP and 150 SPD. Freeze.
12.notification: The cold has no limit. The world has stopped. This is absolute zero.

1.name: Phase 1: Spark
1.effects: A single trace of electrical energy inside a plain blade. Dim, sparse, barely anything to look at. Base 333 DMG and 40 HP.

2.name: Phase 2: Charge
2.effects: Small arcs jump around the blade and occasionally a tiny spark escapes. Base 666 DMG and 99 HP.

3.name: Phase 3: Current
3.effects: Electricity flows continuously: thin lines along the blade and small arcs reaching for the ground. Base 1,666 DMG and 333 HP.

4.name: Phase 4: Voltage
4.effects: The blade stores dangerous electrical pressure: brighter arcs, small lightning flashes and a noticeably stronger aura. Base 3,666 DMG and 666 HP.
4.notification: The pressure rises. Do not let it discharge.

5.name: Phase 5: Collapse
5.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The stored energy is simply gone: an extremely dim blade, broken arcs, almost no aura. Unlocks Zap [Z] — the nearest enemy within your swing range takes 125% damage and is stunned for 1.75s. Base 6 DMG and 66 HP.
5.notification: ...Nothing. Where did it go? ...No. It is still there.

6.name: Phase 6: Surge
6.effects: The stored energy erupts: strong lightning arcs, bright trails and sparks surrounding the wielder. Base 16,999 DMG and 9,999 HP.

7.name: Phase 7: Arc
7.effects: The electricity becomes focused rather than chaotic: sharp arcs travel along the blade and every strike leaves precise trails. Base 36,666 DMG and 26,666 HP.

8.name: Phase 8: Thunder
8.effects: Strikes begin producing thunderous force: larger flashes, heavier impacts and electrical particles clinging to whatever survives. Base 86,000 DMG and 66,666 HP.
8.notification: You heard that. That was the blade.

9.name: Phase 9: Lightning
9.effects: Real lightning, not merely electrical energy: bolts on every attack, a bright aura and the sword briefly grounding itself. Base 106,666 DMG and 133,333 HP.

10.name: Phase 10: Stormbolt
10.effects: The electricity of a concentrated storm: multiple lightning layers, thunder flashes and distortion around the blade. Base 166,666 DMG and 333,333 HP.
10.notification: The storm has found a point.

11.name: Phase 11: Overcharge
11.effects: More electricity than the sword should be able to hold: constant activity, energy leaking off the blade and distortion around the wielder. Base 333,333 DMG and 777,777 HP.
11.notification: Too much power. Not enough blade.

12.name: Phase 12: Thunderstrike
12.effects: A weaponised lightning strike: columns of lightning, massive trails and bolts that follow the swing path itself. Base 633,333 DMG and 1,666,666 HP.
12.notification: You cannot outrun lightning. You can only be struck.

13.name: Phase 13: Cataclysm
13.effects: Catastrophic electrical levels: huge arcs, multiple discharges and lightning crawling across the whole blade. Base 799,999 DMG and 2,200,000 HP.

14.name: Phase 14: Malicious Thunderbolt
14.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: MALICIOUS THUNDERBOLT. Voltstrike no longer generates lightning — it has become a malicious thunderbolt given form, barely containing the energy inside it. Base 1,333,333 DMG, 3,666,666 HP and 160 SPD. STRIKE.
14.notification: You called it lightning. You called it thunder. You were wrong. This is something worse.

1.name: Phase 1: Glimmer
1.effects: A pale sliver of light held inside a plain edge. Faint, steady, and brighter than it has any right to be. Base 120 DMG and 400 HP.
1.notification: Light. Small, but it is not going out.

2.name: Phase 2: Glow
2.effects: The blade warms and starts to carry its own light, leaving short bright streaks behind every swing. Base 480 DMG and 1,600 HP.
2.notification: It is not reflecting anything. It is making its own.

3.name: Phase 3: Gleam
3.effects: Hard light runs along the edge in a continuous line, and sparks of it fall away as you move. Base 1,900 DMG and 6,500 HP.
3.notification: Bright enough to hurt to look at.

4.name: Phase 4: Beam
4.effects: The blade stops looking like a blade and starts looking like a held beam, with a bright halo and light spilling off both edges. Base 7,200 DMG and 25,000 HP.
4.notification: It is not a shape any more. It is a direction.

5.name: Phase 5: Radiance
5.effects: Light pours off the blade as a field rather than a line: a glowing ring around the wielder and rays thrown clear with every strike. Base 26,000 DMG and 95,000 HP.
5.notification: The light has stopped staying in the blade.

6.name: Phase 6: Solaris
6.effects: A small sun bound into steel: layered light, heat distortion and flares that linger after the swing has ended. Base 88,000 DMG and 300,000 HP.
6.notification: Everything you have swung at is still lit up.

7.name: Phase 7: Eclipse
7.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The light is blocked, not lost: a dull grey blade with only a thin rim of glow surviving. Unlocks Flash [Z] — a burst of light that deals 220% damage and stuns everything within your swing range for 1.4s. Base 9 DMG and 60 HP.
7.notification: ...Where did it go? Something is standing in front of it.

8.name: Phase 8: Daybreak
8.effects: The block lifts and the light comes back all at once, brighter than before the eclipse: long rays, a strong halo and light pooling on the ground. Base 200,000 DMG and 680,000 HP.
8.notification: It came back. It came back angry.

9.name: Phase 9: Zenith
9.effects: The light reaches its highest point and holds there: steady, unwavering, throwing long shadows in every direction. Base 370,000 DMG and 1,250,000 HP.
9.notification: Noon. Exactly noon. It will not move.

10.name: Phase 10: Corona
10.effects: A layered ring of light forms permanently around the blade, constant flares peeling off it and heat bending the air behind you. Base 620,000 DMG and 2,100,000 HP.
10.notification: The light has structure now. Layers. It is wearing a crown.

11.name: Phase 11: Halo
11.effects: The radiance settles into orbit: rotating halos around the wielder, light that folds back on itself and a glare that never quite fades. Base 960,000 DMG and 3,200,000 HP.
11.notification: It is not shining at you any more. It is shining around you.

12.name: Phase 12: Occultation
12.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The light is hidden again — a stone-grey blade with a single surviving seam of glow, but the blade underneath is no longer harmless. Unlocks Radiance [X] — a 4s aura that heals 10% of max HP per second while burning every enemy inside it for 45% damage each second. Base 210,000 DMG and 470,000 HP.
12.notification: Hidden. Not gone. Hidden things still burn.

13.name: Phase 13: Supernova
13.effects: The blade is a contained detonation: blinding core, expanding shells of light and rays that keep travelling after the swing stops. Base 1,500,000 DMG and 4,600,000 HP.
13.notification: It is not growing any more. It is about to let go.

14.name: Phase 14: Eternal Noon
14.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ETERNAL NOON. Lumen no longer emits light — it is the source, and the light simply never stops arriving. There is no shadow left anywhere near you. Base 2,000,000 DMG, 6,000,000 HP and 118 SPD. Shine.
14.notification: The sun is not in the sky any more. It is in your hand, and it is not setting.

1.name: Phase 1: Null
1.effects: The blade takes light but gives nothing back — a dark core under a thin pale rim. Heavy for its size. Base 900 DMG and 12,000 HP.

2.name: Phase 2: Dusk
2.effects: The rim thickens and the dark inside the blade deepens, pulling the light out of the air around it. Base 2,100 DMG and 30,000 HP.
2.notification: The light is not staying around you.

3.name: Phase 3: Shade
3.effects: Distortion gathers along the edge: a faint field that eats colour from anything standing near it. Base 4,800 DMG and 70,000 HP.
3.notification: You can see it working. Everything looks duller.

4.name: Phase 4: Veil
4.effects: A veil of void trails the blade, dimming everything it passes over and leaving a dark wake behind every swing. Base 11,000 DMG and 160,000 HP.
4.notification: It is not swinging through the air. It is swinging through what the air used to be.

5.name: Phase 5: Hollow
5.effects: The blade is genuinely empty inside — a shell of void with nothing in it, and loose matter drifts toward the edge and does not come back. Base 25,000 DMG and 360,000 HP.
5.notification: It is hollow. It still cuts. Nothing about that makes sense.

6.name: Phase 6: Grasp
6.effects: The emptiness has a pull now: debris, dust and light all lean toward the blade and vanish at the edge. Base 56,000 DMG and 800,000 HP.
6.notification: It is reaching for things. It does not need you to aim it.

7.name: Phase 7: Unmaking
7.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The pull turns inward and eats its own edge: a blunt grey blade with a hairline of violet left along the spine. Unlocks Gravity Well [Z] — rips every enemy within 3x your swing range toward you and deals 180% damage. Base 15 DMG and 150 HP.
7.notification: ...It took itself apart. ...And now it wants to take something else.

8.name: Phase 8: Abyss
8.effects: The blade re-forms around the pull and is deeper than it was: a black core ringed in violet, with matter visibly bending into it. Base 126,000 DMG and 1,750,000 HP.
8.notification: It put itself back together with something extra.

9.name: Phase 9: Oblivion
9.effects: A vertical tear in the world: the void core is permanent and the violet rim burns brighter the more it consumes. Base 285,000 DMG and 3,800,000 HP.
9.notification: It is not a weapon with a void in it. It is a void with a handle.

10.name: Phase 10: Event Horizon
10.effects: The pull has a boundary now: a hard ring beyond which nothing returns, drawn in bent violet light around the blade. Base 640,000 DMG and 8,200,000 HP.
10.notification: There is a line around it. Do not be on the wrong side.

11.name: Phase 11: Singularity
11.effects: Everything collapses to a single point: a white-hot violet knot with the whole blade bending around it and light spiralling inward. Base 1,440,000 DMG and 17,500,000 HP.
11.notification: It has stopped being a hole. It is a point, and it is very heavy.

12.name: Phase 12: Unravelling
12.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The singularity comes apart along its own seams: a scarred black blade with violet light leaking through the cracks, and far more behind the cracks than before. Unlocks Erasure [X] — instantly erases every enemy below 25% HP within 3x your swing range, and deals 200% damage to those above it. Base 330,000 DMG and 690,000 HP.
12.notification: ...Undone. Again. ...Fine. Then let it undo theirs.

13.name: Phase 13: Voidwake
13.effects: The blade drags a wake of absent space behind it, and anything caught in that wake keeps falling into it after the swing has passed. Base 1,950,000 DMG and 24,000,000 HP.
13.notification: It is leaving holes behind and they are not closing.

14.name: Phase 14: Erebus
14.effects: Primordial dark given an edge: the blade no longer needs a void inside it because everything around it is already becoming one. Base 2,600,000 DMG and 32,000,000 HP.
14.notification: This is older than the dark you are used to.

15.name: Phase 15: Absolute Void
15.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ABSOLUTE VOID. Umbra has stopped containing an absence and started being one — there is simply no longer a version of the world where this blade is not here. Base 3,400,000 DMG, 42,000,000 HP and 92 SPD. Cease.
15.notification: Nothing was taken. Nothing was destroyed. There was just never anything there.

1.name: Phase 1: Droplet
1.effects: One drop of blood, stretched until it is roughly the shape of an edge. It barely cuts and it barely holds. Base 3 DMG and 12 HP.
1.notification: That is not a sword. That is a drop of blood doing an impression.

2.name: Phase 2: Cut
2.effects: The drop thins into an actual edge. Thin, wet, and disappointing — but it does open things. Base 8 DMG and 30 HP.

3.name: Phase 3: Bleed
3.effects: Blood runs continuously off the edge now, leaving a wet red trail through the air behind every swing. Base 22 DMG and 75 HP.
3.notification: It is leaking. It does not seem to care.

4.name: Phase 4: Wound
4.effects: The blade is an open wound that has been convinced to hold a shape: raw, red, and visibly closing and reopening as you move. Base 60 DMG and 190 HP.
4.notification: It is healing. It is healing wrong.

5.name: Phase 5: Hemorrhage
5.effects: Blood sprays clear of the blade in arcs, and the wet trail it leaves behind lingers far too long. Base 150 DMG and 480 HP.
5.notification: This is not dripping. This is escaping.

6.name: Phase 6: Bloodloss
6.effects: The blade is losing more than it can replace: a dark, wet shape with a permanent tremor and a pool forming under the wielder. Base 380 DMG and 1,200 HP.
6.notification: It is bleeding out. So is everything near it.

7.name: Phase 7: Flatline
7.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The blood stops moving and the blade goes still and grey — no pulse, no trail, nothing. Unlocks Bloodletting [Z] — pay 15% of your current HP to deal 400% damage to everything within your swing range and heal for 30% of what it deals. Base 4 DMG and 25 HP.
7.notification: ...Nothing. No pulse. ...Then what is it still doing in my hand?

8.name: Phase 8: Rebound
8.effects: The pulse slams back all at once, and the blade is suddenly heavier and much more alive than the phase before it. Base 1,200 DMG and 4,200 HP.
8.notification: There it is. That is a heartbeat.

9.name: Phase 9: Pulse
9.effects: The whole blade beats in time with the wielder, and every beat throws a ring of blood outward. Base 4,200 DMG and 16,000 HP.
9.notification: It is keeping time. Your time.

10.name: Phase 10: Throb
10.effects: The pulse is irregular and much too strong — the blade swells and contracts, and the ring of blood thrown out with each beat is thick enough to blind. Base 15,000 DMG and 60,000 HP.
10.notification: That is not a healthy rhythm. Do not care.

11.name: Phase 11: Crimson
11.effects: The blood has stopped being red fluid and started being red light: a saturated crimson field with veins running through it and a permanent spray off both edges. Base 52,000 DMG and 220,000 HP.
11.notification: It has stopped looking wet. It has started looking hungry.

12.name: Phase 12: Fester
12.effects: The rot reaches the core and the blade stops being weak — this is where the fragile half of the curve ends. Unlocks Exsanguinate [X] — every enemy within 3x your swing range bleeds for 5s, taking 45% damage per second while you heal for 10% of the bleed. Base 510,000 DMG and 1,020,000 HP.
12.notification: ...It rotted. ...It is still spreading. Let it.

13.name: Phase 13: Carnage
13.effects: The sword stops being a weapon and starts being a site: blood everywhere, at every scale, all of it coming out of the blade and none of it coming back. Base 620,000 DMG and 1,200,000 HP.
13.notification: It is not swinging. It is spilling.

14.name: Phase 14: Bloodlust
14.effects: The blade drags a red wake that reaches for survivors on its own, and the more it takes the faster the wielder moves. Base 850,000 DMG and 4,200,000 HP.
14.notification: It wants more than you are giving it. So give it more.

15.name: Phase 15: Crimson Tide
15.effects: A tide of blood follows the blade across the ground and does not recede, rising around everything that is still standing. Base 2,200,000 DMG and 9,000,000 HP.
15.notification: It is not aimed at anything any more. It is just rising.

16.name: Phase 16: Heartstopper
16.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: HEARTSTOPPER. Sanguine has stopped taking blood and started deciding whose it is — every beat of the blade stops something else instead. Base 5,200,000 DMG, 15,000,000 HP and 168 SPD. Stop.
16.notification: Everything that ever beat had to get it from somewhere. This is where it comes back to.

bloodmoon.title: BLOODMOON
bloodmoon.subtitle: The crimson moon rises — darkness descends upon the grassland!
